project.title: Metagenomic survey and whole genome sequencing of antimicrobial resistant bacteria in Japanese wastewater treatment plant
project.description: The purpose of this project is related to metagenomic survey and genomic epidemiology analysis of antimicrobial resistance bacteria (in particular, carbapenem and/or beta-lactam resistant Enterobacteriaceae) in Japanese wastewater treatment plant.
project.center_name: Laboratory of Bacterial Genomics, Pathogen Genomics Center, National Institute of Infectious Diseases
